scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @windops/contracts build && concurrently -k -n api,web "pnpm --filter @windops/api dev" "pnpm --filter @windops/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @windops/contracts build && pnpm --filter @windops/api build && pnpm --filter @windops/web build
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/compose.dev.yml up -d --wait postgres mailpit && pnpm db:provision && docker compose -f infra/compose.dev.yml --profile sync up -d --wait electric
scripts.db:provision: docker compose -f infra/compose.dev.yml exec -T postgres sh /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/20-provision-roles.sh
scripts.db:setup: pnpm infra:up && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:provision
